weapons.descriptionEn: "Beretta 687 EELL Diamond Pigeon is a finely balanced and responsive double barrel 12 gauge shotgun. It has luxurious details with the added benefit of a wider rib for better target acquisition." 687 EELL Diamond Pigeon is an over-and-under shotgun with a full-length barrel and top rib, allowing for much better firepower at longer distances than other shotguns. Because of its very tight pellet spread, it can one-hit-kill enemies up to the medium range and inflict critical damage on enemies at long range.

weapons.descriptionEn: The 9A-91 is one of the world’s smallest rifles. Made in Russia it is lightweight and can be used for fast combat deployment. 9A-91 has a small yet compact design, allowing it to fire very fast along with high accuracy. Besides that, this weapon is also lightweight and has fast drawing and reloading time. The only downside is that the 9A-91 has a small magazine capacity (20 rounds, plus 60 in reserve), so it can easily run dry, often without being able to kill the target due to its low damage per bullet.
